node.title: Re: url issues using HTTP::Tiny
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: As per the [mod://HTTP::Tiny] docs, a status code of 599 is a fake code that indicates an internal error, and you should check $response->{content} for the actual error message. Since you're accessing SSL sites, you also want to make sure you have [mod://IO::Socket::SSL] 1.56 or greater and [mod://Net::SSLeay] 1.49 or greater installed.
